_comment_disk_config: Deliberately no disk_config here - real disk device paths (/dev/vda, /dev/sda, /dev/nvme0n1, ...) are hardware-specific and unsafe to guess on a stranger's machine (confirmed live, 16 Sept 2026: a hardcoded /dev/vda from this project's own original QEMU dev-VM silently failed on real hardware with a different device name, writing into the live ISO's own tiny overlay filesystem instead of erroring cleanly). Every other JAZZ-specific choice below (Hyprland, Btrfs, kernel, etc.) is still fully pre-answered; run archinstall WITHOUT --silent so it uses all of this automatically and only interactively prompts for disk selection - the one piece that has to stay a human, per-machine decision. Matches archinstall's own officially-supported behavior (config values pre-fill, missing fields prompt) and the same pattern Omarchy's own pre-ISO installer used.
